definitions.gloss: drinking party; banquet; occasion where alcohol is served
definitions.explanation: A gathering or event where alcoholic drinks are served, ranging from formal banquets to casual drinking parties. A somewhat formal term.

examples.japanese: {酒席|しゅせき}でのマナーを{守|まも}る。
examples.english: To observe proper manners at a drinking party.

examples.japanese: {酒席|しゅせき}で{失言|しつげん}してしまった。
examples.english: I made an unfortunate remark at the drinking party.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}の{付|つ}き{合|あ}いで{酒席|しゅせき}に{出|で}ることが{多|おお}いが、{最近|さいきん}は{断|ことわ}るようにしている。
examples.english: I often attend drinking parties for work-related socializing, but lately I've been declining.

notes:
Composed of {酒|しゅ} (alcohol) + {席|せき} (seat/occasion). A formal term for a gathering where alcohol is the central element. More elevated in register than {飲|の}み{会|かい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒席|しゅせき}を{設|もう}ける: to arrange a drinking party
- {酒席|しゅせき}での{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い: behavior at a drinking gathering
- {酒席|しゅせき}に{招|まね}かれる: to be invited to a drinking party
- {酒席|しゅせき}で{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる: to liven up at a banquet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲|の}み{会|かい}: drinking party — the everyday, casual term
- {宴会|えんかい}: banquet; party — often larger and more formal
- {宴席|えんせき}: banquet seat/occasion — very similar, slightly more formal
- {懇親会|こんしんかい}: social gathering — focuses on networking and socializing
